title: Exposing Non-HTTP/SNI Applications
zh: 暴露非 HTTP 與非 SNI 應用程式

q.q: Which kinds of services can Ingress and Route resources expose?
o: HTTP services and TLS services that support SNI
q.e: Ingress 與 Route 使用 HTTP Virtual Hosting，只能暴露 HTTP 與支援 SNI 的 TLS 加密服務，其他協定需要不同的資源。

q.q: Why can't Ingress and Route resources expose an SSH or MySQL service?
o: They rely on HTTP virtual hosting, and these protocols are not HTTP
Routes cannot use port 22 or 3306 due to quotas
q.e: SSH、LDAP、MySQL 屬二進位協定，不是 HTTP，無法用 HTTP Virtual Hosting 區分，需改用 NodePort 或 LoadBalancer Service。

q.q: Which of these is classified in the course as a text-based protocol that Routes cannot expose?
q.e: 簡報把 SMTP、POP3、IMAP 歸類為文字協定，因為不是 HTTP，需要其他資源暴露。

q.q: What does the course recommend as the first choice for exposing applications externally?
o: Use Ingress and Route resources, and use other resources only when the protocol is not HTTP or does not support SNI
Use additional pod networks for all external access
q.e: 優先使用 Ingress 與 Route；只有在協定不是 HTTP 或不支援 SNI 時，才改用 NodePort 或 LoadBalancer Service。

q.q: Which service type is the default and provides a stable address only inside the cluster?
q.e: ClusterIP 是預設類型，只在 Cluster 內部提供穩定的位址，外部網路無法直接連線。

q.q: How do external clients reach a NodePort service?
o: By connecting to NodeIP:NodePort, because a static port is opened on every node
Through an address from a MetalLB pool
Only through a VPN to the pod network
q.e: NodePort 在每個 Node 上開啟靜態 Port，外部以 NodeIP:NodePort 存取。

q.q: In a cloud environment such as AWS, Azure, IBM Cloud, or GCP, what happens when you create a LoadBalancer service?
o: The cloud provider creates a load balancer for each service, which incurs cost
All LoadBalancer services share one free load balancer
OpenShift converts it to a NodePort service
The service stays pending until MetalLB is installed
q.e: 在雲端環境，雲端供應商會為每個 LoadBalancer Service 建立一個 Load Balancer，會產生費用。

q.q: In a bare-metal cluster without a cloud provider, what can provide external addresses for LoadBalancer services?
o: The MetalLB Operator, using an address pool prepared by the administrator
The Cluster Network Operator's default route
q.e: Bare-metal 環境沒有雲端供應商，位址取自管理員預先準備的位址池，由 MetalLB Operator 提供。

q.q: In which environments is MetalLB applicable according to the course?
o: Bare-metal clusters and clusters running on a hypervisor
q.e: MetalLB 適用於 Bare-metal，以及執行在 Hypervisor 上的 Cluster。

q.q: Which custom resources do you create in the metallb-system project to configure MetalLB?
q.e: 在 metallb-system Project 中建立 MetalLB、IPAddressPool 與 L2Advertisement 三種資源。

q.q: What does an IPAddressPool resource define?
o: The range of addresses that can be assigned to services
The DNS servers for the cluster
The list of nodes that run MetalLB speakers
q.e: IPAddressPool 定義可分配給 Service 的位址範圍，由管理員預先準備。

q.q: Which protocol does MetalLB use in its default layer 2 mode?
q.e: Layer 2 模式使用 ARP，為預設模式，設定比較簡單。

q.q: Which MetalLB mode uses BGP and requires an AS number?
q.e: Layer 3 模式使用 BGP，需要 AS Number，適合有路由設備的網路環境。

q.q: What do the two MetalLB modes have in common?
o: MetalLB assigns external addresses from an address pool; they differ in how the address is advertised
Both work only in the cloud
q.e: 兩種模式都由 MetalLB 從位址池分配外部位址，差別在於如何把位址通告給外部網路 (ARP 或 BGP)。

q.q: Which field in a Service manifest creates a load balancer service?
q.e: 在 Service 的 type 欄位指定 LoadBalancer 即可建立 LoadBalancer Service。

q.q: Which command creates a LoadBalancer service for a Deployment that listens on port 8554?
q.e: oc expose deployment/NAME 搭配 --type LoadBalancer 與 --target-port 建立 LoadBalancer Service。

q.q: After creating a LoadBalancer service, the EXTERNAL-IP column shows 'pending'. What does this mean?
o: An external address has not been assigned yet
The service is misconfigured and will never work
The service is only reachable through a route
q.e: 位址尚未分配時，oc get service 的 EXTERNAL-IP 顯示 pending。

q.q: Besides 'oc get service', where can you read the load balancer address with JSONPath?
q.e: 可用 JSONPath 讀取 Service 狀態中的 .status.loadBalancer.ingress。

q.q: In the guided exercise, the MetalLB address pool contains two addresses and you create three LoadBalancer services. What happens?
o: The first two services get external addresses, and the third stays pending
All three services share the two addresses
The third service gets a NodePort address
The creation of the third service fails with an error
q.e: 位址池只有兩個位址，前兩個 Service 取得外部位址，第三個 Service 的 EXTERNAL-IP 維持 pending。

q.q: In the guided exercise, how does the third service obtain an external address?
o: By deleting another LoadBalancer service, which releases an address
By converting the service to NodePort
q.e: 刪除 virtual-rtsp-1 Service 釋放一個位址後，第三個 Service 取得被釋放的位址。

q.q: In the guided exercise, which tool checks that the load balancer port accepts connections?
q.e: 練習以 nc 搭配 -vz 檢查 Port 可連線，再以 VLC 開啟 rtsp 網址驗證影像串流。

q.q: What does the pod network provide in Kubernetes?
q.e: Pod Network 提供所有 Pod 之間的網路通訊；Service Network 則為 Service 提供穩定的位址。

q.q: What does the service network provide?
o: Stable addresses for services that run on pods
q.e: Service Network 為執行在 Pod 上的 Service 提供穩定的位址。

q.q: Which CNI plug-in connects pods to additional networks inside or outside the cluster?
q.e: Multus CNI 把 Pod 連接到額外的網路，網路可在 Cluster 內部或外部。

q.q: Which operators are listed in the course as related to additional networks?
o: Kubernetes NMState Operator and SR-IOV Network Operator
Cluster Samples Operator and Ingress Operator
q.e: 簡報列出相關 Operator 為 Kubernetes NMState Operator 與 SR-IOV Network Operator。

q.q: On ROSA, ARO, and OSD, which attachment types are NOT supported, and what should you use instead?
o: Bridge, MACVLAN, IPVLAN, and host-device; use a layer 2 UDN instead
UDN and CUDN; use bridge instead
NodePort and LoadBalancer; use routes instead
q.e: 託管式服務不支援 Bridge、MACVLAN、IPVLAN 與 Host-device 附加，請改用 Layer 2 的 UDN。

q.q: Who creates a UserDefinedNetwork (UDN), and what does OVN-Kubernetes create after it?
o: A project administrator creates it, and OVN-Kubernetes creates a corresponding NAD
A cluster administrator creates it, and OVN-Kubernetes creates a route
Any developer creates it, and Multus deletes the default network
The MetalLB Operator creates it automatically
q.e: UDN 由 Project 管理員建立，建立後由 OVN-Kubernetes 建立對應的 NAD。

q.q: How does a ClusterUserDefinedNetwork (CUDN) select the namespaces it applies to?
o: With a list of pod names
q.e: CUDN 由 Cluster 管理員建立，以 Label 或 matchExpressions 選取多個 Namespace。

q.q: Which is listed as a benefit of user-defined networks?
o: Tenant isolation and simpler configuration than NetworkPolicy
Automatic TLS encryption of all traffic
q.e: UDN 的優點包含 Tenant 隔離、設定比 Network Policy 簡單，以及 IP 位址一致。

q.q: With user-defined networks, can different namespaces reuse the same subnet?
o: Yes; IP addresses are consistent and different namespaces can reuse the same subnet
No; every subnet must be unique in the cluster
Only if they are in the same CUDN
q.e: 簡報指出 UDN 的 IP 位址一致，不同 Namespace 可重複使用相同的子網路。

q.q: What happens to pods in a namespace after a primary UDN is created?
o: They use the UDN as their primary network interface instead of the default network
They keep the default network and ignore the UDN
They get only a secondary interface
q.e: Primary UDN 取代預設網路，成為 Pod 的主要網路介面，因此與預設網路隔離。

q.q: What is the difference between a secondary UDN and a primary UDN?
o: With a secondary UDN, only traffic for that network uses the additional interface
A secondary UDN replaces the default network
A secondary UDN applies to the whole cluster
q.e: Secondary UDN 只有該網路的流量走額外介面；Primary UDN 則取代預設網路成為主要介面。

q.q: Which label must a namespace have to use a UDN or CUDN as its primary network?
q.e: Namespace 必須有 k8s.ovn.org/primary-user-defined-network Label，才能以 UDN 或 CUDN 作為主要網路介面。

q.q: When can the primary-user-defined-network label be set on a namespace?
o: Only when the namespace is created
At any time with oc label
Only after the UDN is created
q.e: 簡報強調這個 Label 只能在建立 Namespace 時設定。

q.q: A namespace has the primary UDN label but no UDN has been created yet. What happens to pods in it?
o: They do not start until the UDN is created
They start on the default network
They start with no network interfaces
They are scheduled to other namespaces
q.e: UDN 建立之前，Namespace 內的 Pod 不會啟動。

q.q: Which topologies does a UDN support?
q.e: UDN 的拓撲有 Layer 2 與 Layer 3；Role 可為 Primary 或 Secondary。

q.q: In the UDN example, what does 'ipam: lifecycle: Persistent' indicate?
o: The address management lifecycle is persistent
The subnet is shared with the default network
q.e: 範例使用 Layer2 拓撲、Primary 角色、子網路 10.0.0.0/16，位址管理 (IPAM) 的生命週期為 Persistent。

q.q: What limitation applies when creating a UDN from the web console (Networking → UserDefinedNetworks)?
o: Only one UDN can be created per namespace
The namespace label is added automatically
Only cluster administrators can use it
q.e: 在 Web Console 建立時，每個 Namespace 只能建立一個 UDN。

q.q: Why must a CUDN name be unique?
o: A NAD with the same name as the CUDN is created in every matching namespace
CUDN names are used as DNS host names
The name is used as the MetalLB pool name
OVN-Kubernetes uses it as the node name
q.e: CUDN 建立後，每個符合的 Namespace 都會建立與 CUDN 同名的 NAD，因此名稱必須是唯一的。

q.q: Which command lists the NADs that OVN-Kubernetes manages across all namespaces?
q.e: 以 oc get net-attach-def 搭配 -A 與 Label 選擇器 k8s.ovn.org/user-defined-network，列出 OVN-Kubernetes 管理的 NAD。

q.q: What is the purpose of the k8s.ovn.org/open-default-ports annotation?
o: To open specific ports to the default network
q.e: 簡報指出 k8s.ovn.org/open-default-ports Annotation 可對預設網路開放 Port。

q.q: Which NAD types are supported according to the course?
q.e: NAD 支援 host-device、bridge、IPVLAN 與 MACVLAN 類型。

q.q: In a NetworkAttachmentDefinition, what does the config field define?
o: The CNI configuration, such as type and IPAM
The list of pods to attach
q.e: NAD 的 config 欄位定義 CNI 設定，例如 type 與 IPAM。

q.q: Which IPAM options does the course mention for a NAD?
o: dhcp, or static with specified addresses
q.e: IPAM 可用 dhcp，或 static 指定位址，例如 172.25.150.140/24。

q.q: Besides creating NAD resources, where else can additional networks be defined?
o: In the Cluster Network Operator configuration with additionalNetworks and rawCNIConfig
In a Helm chart's values.yaml only
q.e: 也可在 Cluster Network Operator 設定 additionalNetworks 與 rawCNIConfig 來定義額外網路。

q.q: Which annotation in a pod template attaches the pod to a NAD?
q.e: 在 Pod Template 以 k8s.v1.cni.cncf.io/networks Annotation 指定 NAD 名稱；多個名稱之間不要有空格。

q.q: After Multus attaches an additional network, what is the name of the additional interface in the pod?
q.e: Multus 會把額外介面命名為 net1，並記錄於 network-status Annotation；UDN 的介面則是 ovn-udn1。

q.q: In the guided exercise, why does database-udn fail to connect to database-nad by its default network address?
o: database-udn is on an isolated primary UDN, so there is no route to the default network address
database-nad has a NetworkPolicy that denies all traffic
q.e: database-udn 位於 UDN 的 ovn-udn1 介面，與預設網路隔離，所以連 database-nad 的預設網路位址會失敗 (No route to host)。

q.q: In the guided exercise, which NAD configuration connects database-nad to the physical network?
o: host-device type on ens4 with the static address 172.25.150.140/24
bridge type on ens3 with DHCP
MACVLAN type on eth0 with DHCP
q.e: 練習建立 host-device 類型的 NAD，使用 ens4 介面與靜態位址 172.25.150.140/24；ens3 是 Cluster 網路。

q.q: In the guided exercise, why does the connection from workstation to the database on the additional network time out while the connection from utility succeeds?
o: The workstation machine has no access to that physical network
The database pod is not running
The NAD uses DHCP and the address changed
q.e: utility 機器在該實體網路上，所以 psql 連線成功；workstation 無法存取該網路，因此連線逾時。
